v.consequence: The consolidation target is one channel-production program parameterized by per-channel JSON (channel.json already carries the identity a consolidated program needs), with the five packages migrated one at a time; a build of that program was commissioned 2026-09-02 under youtube-channel-production-services-section.
findings: All five channel packages are git submodules with separate GitHub repositories; the federation service is inline in bare-cedar-fog and has no CI.

Every channel's GitHub Actions lane has been on its cron since 2026-08-31 and the automation-state branch of every channel holds only a .gitkeep or README: no scheduled production run has ever persisted a receipt.
Last public videos: AI GclkrGj49co, mathematics 80BOJp0Ys2Y, emsenn MMxRvrJBBjE, all 2026-07-22; business fRnoCLDnn2g never confirmed public; ecological only a legacy pilot. Nothing published since.

scripts/scheduled-production.mjs in each channel is a secret-leak and state-carrier guard, not a pipeline; the vendored channel-runtime/job.mjs exists in three md5 variants; the emsenn channel's Dockerfile bypasses it.

The runners (alternating, daily-cinematic, daily, free-production) share one shape: activation gate, select next item, form order, render, admit receipt, claim release slot, refresh OAuth, schedule, assert a scheduled-not-observed receipt. Their A2A status, pending-publication selection, release distribution, OAuth setup, and civil-day slot arithmetic are semantically identical across channels; jsnode_duplication found 117 candidates.

Genuinely channel-specific: what to make next (curriculum DAG, place market, topic file), source acquisition (curriculum packages, NASA NEX, Gemini research), inference (only emsenn, direct Gemini, not through inference-dispatch), thumbnail (only emsenn), analytics (only emsenn in depth).

Stages with no shared owner anywhere in the registry: journal/RSS feed watching, YouTube keyword demand research, topic selection, thumbnail production, container runtime and CI state guard as a package. Stages whose owners exist with zero channel consumers: scholarly-literature-services-section, inference-dispatch-service, notebooklm-services-section, channel-analytics-interpretation-broker.

Not one commit in any of the five repositories is about what video to make or about a video being published; all recent commits are registry, lockfile, .gitkeep, Cloud Run exit, and duplicated dedup passes.
